title: step-n-moduli-substack
description: For a fixed step depth n >= 2, the sub-stack M^(n) of the meta-moduli stack consisting of the closure-equivalence classes whose representatives are primitive step-n substitution rules; the family {M^(n)} stratifies the meta-aperiodic stratum by step depth and carries the corpus's first internal renormalization-group structure.

step.description: the step-depth parameter n; M^(n) is defined for each n >= 2

meta-points.description: the closure-equivalence classes [S] in this sub-stack, one per substitution-matrix structure modulo conjugacy; cardinality grows with n

primitive.description: each representative substitution rule is primitive (some power of its substitution matrix is strictly positive), as required for rank-theorem-based step-depth invariance

stratifies.description: M^(n) is a stratum of the meta-aperiodic stratum: M^meta_aper = (disjoint-union over n >= 2 of M^(n)) disjoint-union M^meta_aper,residue

step-shift.description: the step-shift morphism sigma : M^(n) -> M^(n+1) embeds this sub-stack into the next, giving the ascending chain M^(2) -> M^(3) -> ... whose colimit is a candidate RG-fixed-point
